To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the model construction problem is undecidable and that a model construction method has been developed that is complete for the class of real time systems for which the construction problem is decidable.
the problem of model–construction for real time specifications is decidable and that the model construction problem can be reduced to the problem of model construction for direct specifications.

(i) real time systems can be constructed automatically from real time specifications, and (ii) the construction of real time agents from real time specifications can be reduced to the problem of constructing finite-state agents from temporal specifications, which in turn can be reduced to constructing finite-state systems from propositional specifications.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of methods for automatically constructing real-time systems directly from their real-time specifications.
the automatic construction of real time systems from their specifications.
the automatic synthesis of real time systems.
